name: cio_position_verdict_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: CIO_POSITION_VERDICT_20261104 — SPEC_ONE_POSITION_VERDICT_20261104 §1b (FQ-095): the CIO is the only
producer of a position verdict, the record carries the twelve required fields, an aggregate account is refused,
and the per-(symbol, account) history survives the process that wrote it (append-only, flush + fsync per record).
Hermetic: a tmp_path store; no live database, no broker, no surface.
